title: Netanyahu's party puts Mamdani alongside Iran, Hezbollah leaders on billboard
summary_full: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu's party placed Mayor Mamdani's image on a billboard.  This billboard featured Mamdani alongside leaders hostile to Israel's interests.  Netanyahu is campaigning for re-election amid political challenges in Israel.  He has increasingly used Mamdani's criticism as campaign messaging.  The exchange occurs while Gaza ceasefire efforts remain stalled.
